Chapter 6683: High Heaven Extinguishment

Chapter 6683: High Heaven Extinguishment

“Tribulation Vessel!” The two immortals continued pouring true blood into the avatar.

If all worlds were a calm lake, then the appearance of the avatar caused them to cave. The longer it remained, the deeper the collapse. Eventually, it would form an unimaginable maelstrom tearing everything to shreds. All would cease to exist.

It reached a level where the immortals in Heaven Realm became afraid. Fortunately, it was not here to return Three Immortals to its origin. Its focus was on Li Qiye alone.

“Crackle!” Flashes emanated from Li Qiye - a sign of his personal tribulation.

Just the sign of its coming was out of this world. The tiny lightning arcs resembled divine lightning pillars.

“Boom!” The gaze of the avatar caused a maelstrom to form within Li Qiye. It rotated rapidly, aiming to pull his body, dao, and true fate inside.

External tribulations could be avoided but this came from Li Qiye himself. How could he quell it without destroying himself?

It began sucking in more than just his body. The vicinity and laws of order were affected as well.

Overlords were horrified, let alone anyone weaker.

“Primordial Stabilization.” Li Qiye said softly, releasing a primordial tree growing from the maelstrom itself.

The moment it appeared, it felt as if everything originated from it including the internal tribulation. The maelstrom slowed gradually before stopping. The twisted timeline and spatial fabrics became normal.

“!” The two immortals didn’t expect stabilization.

As for the avatar, it had the will of the high heaven now. It roared and raised both hands, shooting a lightning beam straight at Li Qiye.

“Destroy him!” The two immortals also channeled their energy to assist the avatar.

Li Qiye was utterly surrounded, seemingly embraced by the high heaven’s countess tribulations.

“Such power...” Some observing immortals were horrified.

“Primordial Mastery.” Li Qiye dragged time into the primordial when there was nothing.

However, the high heaven was still there with full dominion. The avatar only grew stronger, turning the primordial into relentless waves of lightning bolts.

“Boom!” The explosions blinded the crowd. Not even immortals can observe the fight.

The temporal dimension shifted from the present to the past and to the present again, depending on the attacks. This was beyond the realm of regular immortals.

After a long while, they regained their vision. Li Qiye and the avatar were nowhere to be found on the battlefield.

“To ashes?” An overlord shuddered.

The full might of the avatar was insane, especially when focused on a single person. This suicidal assault might have been unprecedented.

“To the high heaven.” Evil Transformation and Fiendish Ground thought they had accomplished their goal.

However, they didn’t have time to think since the bolt in their grasp was still active. Lightning arcs surged out of the cracks and wounds in their fortified form.
